newsitem.title: UK: One Brent date kept, one clocked - traders.
newsitem.headline: One Brent date kept, one clocked - traders.

text.p: One of the Brent cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Monday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, while the other was clocked, traders said.
Wall Street trader JP Morgan kept one cargo loading Feb 4-6, while U.S. major Mobil was five o'clocked with the other, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward, market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is five o'clocked when they are left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and thus cannot be passed on as part of a chaine of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
